hypotheses.justification: The statement only mentions `cwComplexPreimage C hp` (which takes only `hp`, `C`, `T2Space B`) and `cwEulerChar`. `hfin` is used only through `nat_card_cell_preimage_of_card_fiber`, via `Nat.card_sigma`, which needs each fibre to be finite. Given `hd` this is derivable or irrelevant. Let `n` be fixed, `cell C n` is finite (`FiniteType.finite_cell`), and `cellPreimageEquiv C hp n : cell (p⁻¹' C) n ≃ Σ i, p⁻¹' {map n i 0}`. Each centre `map n i 0` lies in `C`, so `hd` gives `Nat.card (fibre) = d`. If `d ≠ 0`, every such fibre is finite (`Nat.card ≠ 0` implies `Finite`), so `Nat.card_sigma` applies exactly as before and gives `d * Nat.card (cell C n)`. If `d = 0`, every fibre over a centre is empty or infinite. If all are empty, the sigma type is empty and has card 0. If one is infinite, the sigma type is infinite and `Nat.card` is 0. In both cases the card is 0 = `0 * Nat.card (cell C n)`. So the cellwise equation `Nat.card (cell (p⁻¹' C) n) = d * Nat.card (cell C n)` holds without `hfin`. The rest of the proof uses only `FiniteDimensional.eventually_isEmpty_cell` for `C`, `cellPreimageEquiv`, and `cwEulerChar_eq_sum_range`, none of which use `hfin`. Fibres outside `C` do not appear in the statement. So `hfin` can be omitted, with the case split above replacing the call to `nat_card_cell_preimage_of_card_fiber C hp hfin hd`.
